Desde «Tegrity.AI», el enlace «Worked case and method» abre «From Field Practice to Pre-Standardization: An Extensible Case-Study Framework».
For a complementary reading, see [The maintained early-warning working paper](https://tegrity.ai/minimalistic-regime-aware-early-warning-systems/).
Control burden should be compared among configurations that meet the same objective and evidence obligations, including the human response work they create.
For a complementary reading, see [The four-series Structural Awareness programme](https://tegrity.ai/structural-awareness-program/).
For a complementary reading, see [The next semantic-window assessment](https://tegrity.ai/regime-aware-semantic-windows-mathematical-validation/).
A shared conceptual programme does not make evidence from one research branch a validation of the others.
A regime signal matters operationally only when its evidence, response window and authorized action are specified, not merely when another alarm layer is added.
For a complementary reading, see [The structural limits of AI oversight](https://tegrity.ai/the-limits-of-ai-oversight/).
The programme's forecasts become testable only when their indicators, populations, time windows and disconfirming outcomes are specified.
The forecast becomes testable by asking whether automation creates more compensatory work in processes already dependent on off-map reconciliation.
For a complementary reading, see [What the results establish and what remains open](https://tegrity.ai/when-the-controls-work-annex-8-meaning-contribution-and-limits/).
For a complementary reading, see [The claim-and-evidence reading key](https://tegrity.ai/when-the-controls-work-annex-9-claims-and-evidence-appendix/).

For a complementary reading, see [The Human Intelligence Debt definitions](https://tegrity.ai/human-intelligence-debt/).
Task simulations could vary integration, data quality and expert support separately to examine which assumptions drive a human-work counterfactual.
The task-level protocol operationalizes the earlier role-based framework; its time ratios should not be compared with operator ratios without an explicit conversion model.
The oversight-threshold study tests whether added review and reconciliation outweigh removed work, rather than treating guardrail count as a measure of debt.
A perfectly traceable rule chain cannot recover a decision-relevant distinction that input formation has already removed.
For a complementary reading, see [Minimalistic Regime-Aware Early Warning Systems](https://tegrity.ai/minimalistic-regime-aware-early-warning-systems/).
For a complementary reading, see [Measuring Human Intelligence Debt](https://tegrity.ai/meassuring-human-intelligence-debt/).
For a complementary reading, see [The H1–H3 mathematical and empirical validation proposal](https://tegrity.ai/regime-aware-semantic-windows-mathematical-validation/).
For a complementary reading, see [The bounded urban-control case](https://tegrity.ai/minimum-sufficient-control-architecture-for-ai-enabled-urban-systems/).
